layers.name: foundation
layers.about: the app's own plumbing and generic helpers: the API client, query keys, markdown, environments, analytics

layers.name: client
layers.about: the editor's clients of what it talks to: the platform account and the sandbox daemon's session, endpoint, RPC and queries

layers.name: components
layers.about: UI parts shared by several features that know no feature

layers.name: workbench
layers.about: the services and registries features are written against, one unit per workbench/<x>

layers.name: models
layers.about: domain state and projections several features read: daemon query stores, pure derivations and their words; renders nothing and knows no feature, one unit per models/<x>

layers.name: parts
layers.about: Vue parts that draw one model several features show and know no feature: a provider's logo, an agent's seal, a secret's field; one unit per parts/<x>

layers.name: features
layers.about: one directory per product area; a feature may use another, but no two may form a cycle

layers.name: composition
layers.about: what puts the features on screen: the shell, the router, built-in views, the extension host, local windows
